text: REQUEST TEST: EEG_with_Sleep_Deprivation The "mud" taste suggests an olfactory or gustatory aura, which is highly characteristic of temporal lobe epilepsy. I need to confirm epileptiform activity to rule out other causes of unresponsiveness.

speaker: Doctor
text: The EEG confirms focal seizures originating in the right temporal lobe, which aligns perfectly with your gustatory aura and automatisms. I am confident in my assessment based on these findings. DIAGNOSIS READY: Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
